title: SeeDance 2.5
description: ByteDance SeeDance 2.5 — flagship multimodal video. Text-to-video; image-to-video (start + optional end frame); and reference-to-video mixing up to 30 reference images (free), up to 10 reference video clips (2-30s each, 30s combined — billed per second of INPUT at half the output rate, see POST /v1/cost), and up to 10 reference audio clips (2-30s each, 30s combined, free; audio-only input is supported). Video editing and extension are reference-video modes — no separate edit endpoint. Reference media can't be combined with start/end frames. 480p/720p/1080p, any duration 4-30 seconds, optional audio. Draft mode: `draft` makes a 480p draft at the 480p price, and within 7 days `from_draft_job_id` renders that same video at 1080p (the final), priced at 1080p for the draft's length. 1080p output is H.265 (HEVC) 10-bit; 480p and 720p are H.264. A browser without a hardware HEVC decoder shows H.265 as a black frame with audio — the job status reports the codec in `video_codec`.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. Ignored (adaptive) when a start frame or any reference media sets the frame.

draft.description: Make a 480p draft, priced like any 480p video (150 credits/sec, plus 80/sec of reference-video input). Within 7 days, send its job `id` as `from_draft_job_id` to render the same video at 1080p: the same motion, framing and sound, sharper. Leave `resolution` out.

end_image.description: Optional end frame, used together with `image` (the start frame) to interpolate the video between the two frames. Same input forms as `image`.

from_draft_job_id.description: Render the 1080p final of one of your succeeded drafts, within 7 days of it: the draft job's `id` (a draft made with `draft`, over MCP or in the Video Workshop). Send it with no other parameters (the draft's own `prompt` may come along): the final reuses the draft's prompt, inputs, length, aspect ratio, seed and audio setting. Priced as a 1080p video of the draft's length (750 credits/sec) plus the draft's reference-video input at 375/sec; POST /v1/cost quotes it. GET /v1/videos/{id} on the draft says whether it can still be finalized (`draft_finalizable`), until when (`draft_expires_at`) and the final's standard price (`draft_final_credits`).

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video (no price impact).

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-video. Can't be combined with reference media.

prompt.description: Text description of the video. Required, except with `from_draft_job_id` (a final reuses its draft's prompt). Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_audios.description: Optional reference audio clips (up to 10; each 2-30s, 30s combined; WAV/MP3) that guide sound/voice. Audio-only input is supported. Each item is a public audio URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Free — no input billing. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 30, free) that guide identity/style in reference-to-video mode. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

reference_videos.description: Optional reference video clips (up to 10; each 2-30s — a clip the prompt edits 4-30s — 30s combined; MP4/MOV, ≤50MB each) for editing, extension, and motion/identity guidance. Each item is a public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads (videos are passed by URL, not inlined). Billed on the INPUT duration at half the output per-second rate (80/sec at 480p, 160/sec at 720p, 375/sec at 1080p) in addition to the output — estimate via POST /v1/cost. Can't be combined with `image`/`end_image`.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Pricing varies by resolution — see `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models. A draft (`draft`) is always 480p and its final 1080p: leave resolution out for both. 1080p output is H.265 (HEVC) 10-bit; 480p and 720p are H.264.
